purpose: Repair the owner-only read-only REG.RU control-host readiness diagnostic after the previous SSH transport lost empty optional positional arguments.
requiredInvariants: The workflow is repository-owner-only, issue-4159-only and exact-command gated.
The diagnostic performs no DNS mutation, Caddy reload/write, Compose up/down/restart, container mutation, environment write, database mutation or deployment.
Production SSH validates the canonical REG.RU VPS and pinned host fingerprint using protected repository secrets.
Private keys, fingerprints, protected usernames, production paths, Compose paths and environment values are never printed or posted.
The remote transport does not depend on optional positional arguments.
The production web runtime is discovered only through bounded Docker Compose labels and reduced to sanitized state markers.
PC_CONTROL_HOST_ENABLED is reported only as ENABLED, DISABLED_OR_ABSENT or UNKNOWN.
The issue receives only sanitized DNS, TLS, Caddy, runtime revision and readiness markers.
A successful diagnostic is readiness evidence only and never production cutover evidence.
acceptance: Workflow syntax and security gates pass on the exact head.
The owner-only command reaches a terminal sanitized classification on REG.RU.
The current control A/AAAA state is observed without guessing.
Pinned SSH, Caddy baseline, one running Compose web service, immutable image id, OCI revision and feature-gate state are observed read-only.
No production mutation occurs in any branch of the diagnostic.
No new recurring cost is introduced.
